Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.character

Class Player

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.Entity
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.character.Character
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.character.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
Damageable, Rewindable, Collidable, Updatable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Assassin, Knight
public abstract class Player extends Character
The character the user controls (GDD 1.3.1). Every tick it reads its PlayerInput and walks. Knight, Mage and Archer are its concrete classes.

  • Constructor Details

    • Player

      protected Player(Aabb bodyBox, StatSource stats, Weapon startingWeapon, Armor startingArmor, Aabb hurtbox, int invincibilityTicksAfterHit, PlayerInput input, World world)
      Creates a player that stands still.
      Parameters:
      bodyBox - the box the player occupies in the world; must not be null
      stats - where its stats come from; must not be null
      startingWeapon - the weapon it starts with: its base attack and the first item of its inventory; must not be null
      startingArmor - the armor it starts with, in its inventory; must not be null
      hurtbox - the player's hurtbox; must not be null
      invincibilityTicksAfterHit - invincibility ticks granted after a hit; 0 or more
      input - what the user asks for; must not be null
      world - the world the player walks in, asked what blocks it; must not be null

    • getInventory

      public Inventory getInventory()
      Returns the player's bag: its hotbar, its equipped weapon and its worn armor (GDD 1.4).
      Returns:
      the inventory; never null

    • pickUp

      public final Optional<Item> pickUp(Item item)
      Picks up an item and rebuilds (GDD 1.4): a consumable goes in the hotbar, a passive item in the first free passive slot, a weapon or an armor replaces the one held.
      Parameters:
      item - the item the player walks on
      Returns:
      what is left on the ground: the old weapon or armor, the item itself when no slot takes it, or nothing
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if item is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the item is of no kind the inventory takes

    • dropPassive

      public final Optional<PassiveItem> dropPassive(int slot)
      Takes the passive item out of a slot and rebuilds without it.
      Parameters:
      slot - the passive slot, from 0 to Inventory.PASSIVE_SIZE - 1
      Returns:
      the item to drop on the ground, or nothing if the slot was free
      Throws:
      IndexOutOfBoundsException - if slot is outside the passive slots

    • swapPassiveSlots

      public final void swapPassiveSlots(int first, int second)

    • think

      protected final void think(long tick)
      Starts a dodge roll or a dash when its key is pressed, then either moves one tick of the quick move in progress or walks in the direction of the input and, while the user attacks, starts an attack towards the point as soon as it can (see Character.canAttack()). Then picks up, or interacts when no item lies in reach, and uses, once per press.
      Specified by:
      think in class Character
      Parameters:
      tick - the number of the current logic tick
